page.overview:
Who is Blaster Fire?

Blaster Fire was a female fathier who was born around 0 ABY. They took part in the Canto Cup fathier race that took place in 3 ABY and was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. By the time of the race, Blaster Fire stood at 280 centimeters tall, weighed 919 kilograms. They had brown fur, black eyes and was considered an absolute wild card during a race.

That year, the fathier competed in a Canto Cup race that the scoundrel Kay Vess bet on while watching the competition via hologram.

Blaster Fire appeared in a hologram in the 2024 Massive Entertainment video game Star Wars Outlaws. They are one of the fathiers that can randomly feature in Canto Fathier Racing, an optional activity. In most races, the six fathiers are assigned a random jockey and a random symbol. As such, this article does not assume one pairing or symbol color to be canonical.
